title: Launch HN: Speko (YC S26) – OpenRouter for Voice AI
summary: Speko is a platform that optimizes voice AI workflows by dynamically selecting the best combination of speech-to-text (STT), large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech (TTS) models based on user-defined constraints (accuracy, latency, cost, or balanced). It eliminates the need for manual benchmarking and integration, providing an API-driven solution for enterprises and developers. The platform benchmarks models publicly, ensures failover during connection setup, and offers an open-source gateway for teams preferring self-hosted solutions. Speko addresses common pain points like outdated models, high error rates, and language-specific or domain-specific (e.g., medical) optimization challenges.
key_points: Speko dynamically selects optimal STT, LLM, and TTS models based on constraints (accuracy, latency, cost, or balanced).
Solves the problem of outdated voice AI stacks by continuously benchmarking and updating models.
Publicly benchmarks models and publishes results, including cases where alternatives outperform their selections.
Offers an API for seamless integration and a dashboard for easy model switching.
Includes failover mechanisms during connection setup to ensure reliability.
Open-sourced gateway (MIT license) for self-hosted deployments, avoiding extra network hops and key-sharing.
Supports domain-specific use cases (e.g., medical vocabulary) and multilingual optimization.
Charges for hosted routing and managed keys, while the gateway and BYOK setup remain free.
Trained an automatic TTS naturalness scorer that aligns with human rater preferences.
